evidence.q1: One matrix with a column per supplier (Halloway, Pentlow, Marrick) and criteria as rows.
evidence.q2: Price per axle, lead time, casing warranty and on-site fitting are all rows of that one matrix, with a value in each supplier column.
evidence.q3: An Award rail sits beside the matrix from its top, holding the selected supplier and the 'Award to Halloway Tyre Group' button, with radio selection in the column heads; it is docked alongside the table, not placed after it.
evidence.q4: Above the matrix are a title block, a metadata strip and a summary band ('The headline rate is not the contract cost') with a rank toggle.
evidence.q5: The header metadata is small label/value document fields, not emphasised figures, and the per-supplier terms at the foot are unboxed ruled columns; there is no card grid or KPI row.

evidence.q1: One table with a column per supplier (Ashcombe, Brayford, Ridgeway) and criteria as rows.
evidence.q2: Price per axle, lead time, warranty and on-site fitting groups all sit in that one table, with values for all three suppliers.
evidence.q3: 'Select for award' controls are in the table's column heads, and an 'Award draft' rail is docked top-right beside the main column, so the action is present above the comparison, not below it.
evidence.q4: Above the table are an intro that summarises the result, a metadata block, an 'Engineering recommendation' callout and a basis toggle panel.
evidence.q5: The metadata is body-size label/value fields and the footer is three prose columns; there is no card grid or emphasised stat row.

evidence.q1: One evaluation sheet table with a column per supplier (Maxwell, Border, Clwyd) and criteria as rows.

evidence.q3: A viewport-fixed bottom bar ('No quote chosen yet' / 'Award contract') appears in the first viewport and overlays the full-page capture; 'Choose' radios are in the table.
evidence.q4: Only a page title, a one-line scope sentence and a small vertical contract-facts list precede the sheet; there is no summary or recommendation band.
evidence.q5: The header facts are a vertical key/value list; the rest is the table, with no card grid or stat row.
